title: Making 10
short: Find the number that goes with another to make 10.

blocks.html: 10 is a very important number. Let’s find the partners that make 10. Counting past 10 helps you check.

blocks.name: tenframe

task.text: Fill the ten frame. How many did you add?

blocks.cap: There are 7 counters. Tap the empty squares to fill the frame.

blocks.html: Partners of 10: 1 and 9, 2 and 8, 3 and 7, 4 and 6, 5 and 5.
A ten frame holds exactly 10. The empty squares show how many more you need to make 10.

blocks.title: Make 10
steps: Picture 6 counters in a ten frame.

blocks.html: For grown-ups: Use 10 fingers: hold some up, and ask how many are down. A few each day works well.

sources.name: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics, Kindergarten, K.OA.A.4: for any number from 1 to 9, find the number that makes 10 when added to it
Institute of Education Sciences practice guide: Teaching Math to Young Children (NCEE 2014-4005)
